# datadog_status_page (Resource)

Provides a Datadog Status Page resource. This can be used to create and manage the page-level structure of a Datadog status page. Components are managed via the `datadog_status_page_component` resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "datadog_status_page" "example" {
  name               = "Platform Status"
  domain_prefix      = "platform"
  type               = "internal"
  visualization_type = "bars_and_uptime_percentage"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_prefix` (String) The domain prefix for the status page URL.
- `name` (String) The name of the status page.
- `type` (String) The type of status page. Valid values are `public`, `internal`.
- `visualization_type` (String) How component status is visualized. Valid values are `bars_and_uptime_percentage`, `bars_only`, `component_name_only`.

### Optional

- `company_logo` (String) URL of the company logo displayed on the status page.
- `email_header_image` (String) URL of the image used in subscription email headers.
- `favicon` (String) URL of the favicon for the status page.
- `slack_app_icon` (String) URL of the Slack app icon.
- `slack_subscriptions_enabled` (Boolean) Whether Slack subscriptions are enabled for the status page.
- `subscriptions_enabled` (Boolean) Whether subscriptions are enabled for the status page.

### Read-Only

- `custom_domain` (String) The custom domain configured for the status page.
- `custom_domain_enabled` (Boolean) Whether a custom domain is enabled for the status page.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the status page is published/enabled.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `page_url` (String) The URL of the status page.
